newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria's oil output grew 6.3 pct in 1st half 1996.
newsitem.headline: Algeria's oil output grew 6.3 pct in 1st half 1996.

text.p: Algerian oil production rose 6.3 percent and gas output rose 3.1 percent in the first half of 1996 compared to the previous year, official figures showed on Monday.

Natural gas production rose to 61.1 billion cubic metres in the first half of 1996 compared to 56.5 billion cubic metres in the same period of 1995, according to the government-appointed Social and Economic National Council (CNES).

CNES, quoted by the official Algerian news agency APS, said crude oil production rose 6.3 percent in the first six months of 1996 over the 1995 period but gave no figures. It said refinery production rose 3.7 percent in the period.
Oil and gas provide more than 94 percent of Algerian foreign earnings. Algeria has an OPEC quota of about 750,000 barrels per day and exports over 30 billion cubic metres of gas per year.
